_note: Item tooltips read out of the client by tools/fetch_client_items.py. This is what the game itself shows, so build_database.py trusts it over every sheet. ourName is the name the site uses, which is what the override is keyed on.
_only: Only entries this server wrote are here. The client's itemInfo.lua is a translation of the whole official item database and lists thousands of items no server enables, so every entry is diffed against the release it was built from and the untouched ones are dropped: origin custom means an id the translation never had, edited means the owner rewrote it. An untouched entry is not proof an item is missing, only that nothing here says it is present.
_ambiguous: A display name is not unique in the client, so an entry is only kept when the Type line agrees with the category the site has it under and every remaining candidate reads the same. Anything left over is reported by the script and deliberately not written here, so the sheet keeps the item.

items.flavour: A red velvet hat adorned with Stormy Knight's horns. For some reason, you feel like it would fit perfectly with a Clown Nose...

items.flavour: A hat worn by bishops of the Church of Freya as a symbol of their status. Surely they won't mind you wearing it though.

items.name: Tendrilion Helm
effect: Bleeding Damage +10%
Vulnerable Potency +10%
items.flavour: A hat designed after the king of the Splendide Fields. Wearing it makes you feel like an unparalleled predator.

items.name: Pirate Eyepatch
effect: Gain Immunity to the Blind status
Hit -15
Flee -15
items.flavour: A bandage that covers one of your eyes, making it a bit harder to gauge distance. But at least it'll keep that eye safe.

items.name: Diabolus Crown
effect: For each Diabolus item equipped: Atrophy Resistance +15%
For each Diabolus item equipped: Slowcast Resistance +15%
For each Diabolus item equipped: Curse Resistance +15%
items.flavour: A sinister crown crafted in an ancient, long forgotten era. Wearing it makes you feel as fearless as it makes you look terrifying.

items.name: Ascendant Crown
effect: For each Ascendant Item equipped, Regenerate 1% of Max HP every 5 Seconds
items.flavour: An ornate crown worn by those seeking entry to the Temple of the World Serpent.

items.name: Costume Angelic Feathers
items.flavour: A heavenly blessing causes angelic feathers to flutter in the air around you.

items.name: Apostle's Token
items.flavour: A token belonging to the Apostle of Baphomet, found in the Capitolina Catacombs. In its last moments, did it ever realize the evil it chose to worship had been supplanted by another...?

items.name: Covenant's Mark
items.flavour: A pendant bearing the mark of a covenant sworn between the ancient people of Glast Heim and the forces of darkness. One glance at the ruins there is all it takes to confirm just how well that bargain worked out for them. Very rare.

items.name: Cursed Baphomet Doll
items.flavour: A Doll imbued with Baphomet's curse, or one would suppose. What happened to Baphomet, and how was it replaced by that...thing? Very rare.

items.name: Hoe
items.flavour: A tool for digging or gardening wielded by a strange goblin deep in the Coal Mines. You can only imagine what it was searching for so far away from the Goblin Village. Very rare.

items.name: Mammoth Skin
items.flavour: Rock-hard skin taken from the Mammoth that roams the Manuk Fields. It would make incredible armor if anyone had tools strong enough to work with it. Very rare.

items.name: Mystic Horn
items.flavour: A long, white horn harvested from the Cornus roaming Splendide Fields.

items.name: Horn of Tendrilion
items.flavour: A stiff horn taken from Tendrilion, the apex predator of the Splendide Fields. It was so powerful that the Lapine had to seal it away in an altar to save the wildlife of the Splendide area, nevermind themselves. Very rare.

items.name: Valkyrie Feather
items.flavour: An iridescent feather taken from the wing of a Valkyrie, one of the choosers of the slain.

items.name: Crystalline Teardrop
items.flavour: A crystalline teardrop shed by an Aqua Elemental in its final moments.

items.name: Ancient Coin
items.flavour: An ancient golden coin. It's too old to be used as actual currency anymore...and honestly probably too valuable.

items.name: Withered Blossom
items.flavour: A withered, dessicated flower. It must have been beautiful when it was alive, but no trace of that beauty now remains.

items.name: Spiritual Crystal
items.flavour: A brightly shining jewel found in the depths of Nidhoggur's Nest. Though faint, the power dwelling within it is still unnerving.

items.name: Megalith Shard
items.flavour: A shard taken from one of the mysterious Megaliths roaming the Comodo Caves. Or...sitting still in the Comodo Caves, I suppose.

items.name: Snowflake
items.flavour: A small snowflake that has managed to maintain its form despite the warmth in your hands holding it. Truly a Christmas Miracle.

items.name: Congealed Darkness
items.flavour: A small lump of dark, unidentifiable matter. Its very existence seems to deny everything you know about the physical world.

items.name: Temple Mark
effect: A token handed out by the Sessrumnir Temple as a symbol of gratitude for services rendered. The citizens of Rachel are happy to accept it as a substitute for money.
Account Bound

items.name: Emblem of Honor
items.flavour: A coin engraved with the sigil of Glast Heim, given out as the highest honor by the king himself. You can only wonder at the past of the horrid monster that was carrying this. Very rare.

items.name: Deathly Seed
items.flavour: A seed from the mysterious Black Plant, which only grows in Niflheim. Even then, they are incredibly difficult to find, making their seeds highly sought after.

items.name: Coal Powder
items.flavour: A pile of coal from a massive coal elemental. Unfortunately it had to be reduced to powder to stop it from attacking you.

items.name: Carnium
items.flavour: An unimaginably resilient metal discovered in the New World. It does not seem to appear naturally, but the exact conditions required to produce it remain unknown.

items.name: Bradium
items.flavour: An extremely dense metal found only in the New World. It's properties are not yet well understood, so very few smiths are capable of doing anything with it.

items.name: Contaminated Ash
items.flavour: A dark pile of ash contaminated by pollution from industrial enterprises.

items.name: Wolf's Blood
items.flavour: Blood taken from the colossal beast that once ruled the Audhumbla Grasslands. In a remarkably rare show of cooperation, it took the combined efforts of both the Rachel Loyalists and the Veins Rebels to put the beast down for good. Very rare.

items.name: Yggdrasilid Key
items.flavour: A shining golden key that was ostensibly given to the Raffles by the Yggdrasilids in case of emergency. It has now been recharged, and is capable of taking you to the place where the Yggdrasilids are waiting.

items.name: Enriched Elunium
items.flavour: Concentrated Elunium that has been buried deep underground. Used as a material to strengthen armor. Enhances a chance of successful upgrade. Only Suhnbi of Payon is capable of refining with this material.

items.name: Enriched Oridecon
items.flavour: Dense Oridecon that has been buried deep underground. Used as a material to strengthen weapons. Enhances a chance of successful upgrade. Only Suhnbi of Payon is capable of refining with this material.

items.name: Large Scaraba Helmet
items.flavour: A sturdy helm worn by the larger Scaraba soldiers. It displays an alarming level of artifice for a race of insects.

items.name: Small Scaraba Helmet
items.flavour: A small helmet worn by the smaller Scaraba soldiers. Even the least of the Scaraba seem fully equipped for war.

items.name: Queen's Wing
items.flavour: A fragment of an insect wing taken from the queen of the Scaraba. It shines with a prismatic light. Very rare.

items.name: Elemental Fire
items.flavour: A piece of crystallized elemental energy, born from concentrated fire magic.

items.name: Elemental Water
items.flavour: A piece of crystallized elemental energy, born from concentrated water magic.

items.name: Elemental Wind
items.flavour: A piece of crystallized elemental energy, born from concentrated wind magic.

items.name: Elemental Earth
items.flavour: A piece of crystallized elemental energy, born from concentrated earth magic.

items.name: Falcon Feather
items.flavour: A soft, light feather taken from a falcon trained for battle by the kobolds.

items.name: Golden Feather
items.flavour: A sparkling golden feather taken from one of the little angels roaming around Eclage. It didn't seem to have any feathers when you fought it, so you're not exactly sure where this came from...

items.name: Glistening Powder
items.flavour: Mysterious powder found in the possession of the fairy guarding the Tower of the Morning. You're not sure what purpose it serves.

items.name: Bulgasari Leather
items.flavour: Thick, fire hardened leather from the massive Bulgasari living in the depths of Thor's Volcano.

items.name: Warden's Feather
items.flavour: The feather of the large...falcon? That watches over the Splendide Fields. There was something unnervingly human about the way it looked at you...

items.name: Desert Pear
items.flavour: A mysterious fruit found only in the arid plateaus around Veins. The plants they grow on are incredibly hard to find, but the monsters that live there survive by ferreting them out, and so can often be found carrying their fruit around.

items.name: Santa Bag
items.flavour: A large red bag full near to bursting with gifts and presents. Unfortunately, only Santa knows who their intended recipients were...and why Stormy Knight had them in the first place. Very rare.

items.name: Warrior's Spirit
items.flavour: The condensed physical form of the intense fighting spirit of the heroes lost to Rekember's somatology research. It still rages against the injustice of its betrayal.

items.name: Blood Thirst
items.flavour: The condensed physical form of the intense blood lust of the heroes lost to Rekember's somatology research. There is no quenching the thirst for revenge in those already departed.

items.name: Ghostly Essence
items.flavour: A strange substance left behind by the ghostly wanderers in the Labyrinth Forest. Were it not for this, you might be fooled into believing they had been real people once.

items.name: Savanna Blossom
items.flavour: A soft and elegant flower that has somehow managed to bloom despite the arid climate it called home.

items.name: Shipment Box
items.flavour: A box of nondescript, miscellaneous goods packaged and ready for shipment. Definitely nothing suspicious here.

items.name: Insect Wing
effect: A large wing taken from a large insect.

items.name: Mithril Ingot
effect: An ingot of pure mithril, a magical metal so rare, only the gods and those close to them have any hope of making use of it.
A key ingredient in the crafting of Godly Items

items.name: Mithril Hammer
effect: A hammer forged from Mithril, making it harder and stronger than any earthly metal.
A key ingredient in the crafting of Godly Items

items.name: Mithril Anvil
effect: An anvil forged from Mithril, making it harder and stronger than any earthly metal.
A key ingredient in the crafting of Godly Items

items.name: Divine Rune
effect: An incredible runestone that is capable of bearing the divine power of the original Odinic Runes.
Used in the crafting of Godly Items

items.name: Muspellium
effect: An otherworldly fuel created by fusing together the traces of magic from where reality has started to fray and crumble.
Used in the crafting of Godly Items

items.name: Time Crystal
items.flavour: A glassy crystal which seems to reflect images from different times. It reeks of the same power that is sealed beneath the Clock Tower.

items.name: Coagulated Spell
items.flavour: A crystallization of pure magic found throughout the Kingdom of Glast Heim on the night of its collapse. There is enough energy left in it for it to be turned to another purpose.

items.name: Cursed Coin
items.flavour: An invaluable piece of treasure found deep in the Abyss Lake. Legend says it bears a powerful curse, promising vengeance against those who steal it from its subterranean resting place.

items.name: Blacksmith's Blessing
items.flavour: A mysterious reagent that can be used to reforge metal into almost any shape, and make it harder than ever once it's there. A blacksmith's dream, contained in such a small bottle. Used in the crafting of high-level items.

items.name: Raid Pass
effect: A single-use pass that allows one's guild to participate in a Guild Raid.
This item can be used in the Guild Raid Muster Point at Luina 226,186.
This item is Character Bound, but CAN be placed in Guild Storage.

items.name: Steel Feather
effect: A metallic feather given as a token of gratitude to adventurers by the Steel Wings.
Can be exchanged for rewards at the Steel Wings Headquarters in Luina.
Account Bound

items.name: White Snake Scale
items.flavour: A snow-white scale carried by an especially powerful cultist in the Serpentine Temple. Wherever these cultists came from, it seems they happened upon something quite powerful at the Temple's heart.

items.name: Broken Engine
items.flavour: A damaged machine that was once part of an ancient robot's motor system.

items.name: Dented Iron Plate
items.flavour: A damaged piece of metal taken from a highly advanced machine.

items.name: Burnt Circuit Board
items.flavour: A damaged component taken from the massive defense robot protecting the ruins of Verus. While it was certainly powerful, it didn't seem like it was in control of the robots roaming the ruined city. Is there some other entity uniting the drones in Verus's defense...? Very rare.

items.name: Contaminated Magic
items.flavour: Twisted, corrupting magic condensed into a physical form. Whoever was responsible for doing this to Glast Heim, it seems this is the only evidence of them left in this twisted echo of that day.

items.name: Crystallized Agility
items.flavour: A crystallization of superhuman skill left behind by a Taekwon Master's exploits. Used to add Random Options to Taekwon Gloves.

items.name: Crystallized Endurance
items.flavour: A crystallization of superhuman skill left behind by a Taekwon Master's exploits. Used to add Random Options to Taekwon Gloves.

items.name: Crystallized Discipline
items.flavour: A crystallization of superhuman skill left behind by a Taekwon Master's exploits. Used to add Random Options to Taekwon Gloves.

items.name: Crystallized Precision
items.flavour: A crystallization of superhuman skill left behind by a Taekwon Master's exploits. Used to add Random Options to Taekwon Gloves.

items.name: Crystallized Perfection
items.flavour: A crystallization of superhuman skill left behind by a Taekwon Master's exploits. Used to add Random Options to Taekwon Gloves.

items.name: Spirit of Swordsmanship
effect: Swordsman Only: If the user's Base Level and Job Level are both below 50, can be consumed to immediately increase the user's Base and Job Levels to 50.
Swordsman Only: This is a single use item.
items.flavour: Walking the road with sword and spear for a lifetime, the soul of one who has become a shield for their comrades on the battlefield.

items.name: Spirit of Creation
effect: Merchant Only: If the user's Base Level and Job Level are both below 50, can be consumed to immediately increase the user's Base and Job Levels to 50.
Merchant Only: This is a single use item.
items.flavour: Searching for the deepest secrets of their craft for a lifetime, the soul of one eternally engaged in the divine act of creation.

items.name: Spirit of Thievery
effect: Thief Only: If the user's Base Level and Job Level are both below 50, can be consumed to immediately increase the user's Base and Job Levels to 50.
Thief Only: This is a single use item.
items.flavour: Walking in darkness for lifetime, the soul of one who straddled the line between good and evil.

items.name: Spirit of Magic
effect: Mage Only: If the user's Base Level and Job Level are both below 50, can be consumed to immediately increase the user's Base and Job Levels to 50.
Mage Only: This is a single use item.
items.flavour: Studying magic for lifetime, the soul of one who dedicated their life to uncovering the secrets of the inner workings of the world.

items.name: Spirit of Archery
effect: Archer Only: If the user's Base Level and Job Level are both below 50, can be consumed to immediately increase the user's Base and Job Levels to 50.
Archer Only: This is a single use item.
items.flavour: Reading the flow of song and nature for a lifetime, the soul of one who was free as the wind.

items.name: Spirit of Faith
effect: Acolyte Only: If the user's Base Level and Job Level are both below 50, can be consumed to immediately increase the user's Base and Job Levels to 50.
Acolyte Only: This is a single use item.
items.flavour: Devoting themselves to God's divine purpose for a lifetime, the soul of one who selflessly offered their life for something greater.

items.name: Neural Chip
items.flavour: A tiny mechanical component harvested from one of Juperos's guardians. Some believe the creature's entire mind is contained in this little device...but that would be absurd.

items.name: Sandpaper
items.flavour: A rough, abrasive material used to smooth wooden surfaces. Useful someday maybe, but not today.

items.name: Cosmic Fragment
items.flavour: A large, jewel-like sphere that thrums with barely contained cosmic energy. It feels disturbingly alien.

items.name: Massive Metal Chunk
items.flavour: A massive piece of scrap metal harvested from one of Juperos's guardians. Despite it's enormous size, it weighs next to nothing.

items.name: Massive Fang
items.flavour: A massive fang extracted from a monstrosity found deep in Orc Dungeon. Whatever is creating these disgusting creatures must be stopped.

items.name: Reptile Skin
effect: A sticky piece of skin peeled from a reptile.

items.name: Mud Lump
items.flavour: A lump of wet mud kept soft and moist by the spiritual energies lingering about the Forgotten Tomb.

items.name: Skull
items.flavour: A fully intact human (?) skull taken from a powerful skeleton leader.

items.name: Glittering Shell
items.flavour: An exceptionally rare insect shell that sparkles with dazzling, almost regal light.

items.name: Coral Reef
items.flavour: A small chunk of a reef formed by corals in clear, tropical waters.

items.name: Leaf Bookmark
items.flavour: An old leaf once used as a bookmark in an ancient magical grimoire. Though you are curious what it was marking, you unfortunately had to dispatch with the grimoire in question to get this.

items.name: Executioner's Mitten
items.flavour: A glove worn by a torturer that inhabited the Glast Heim Prison. Was she there since the glory days of Glast Heim, or did she arrive sometime after its fall?

items.name: Young Twig
items.flavour: A fresh, young twig that evokes feelings of purity and innocence. Very rare.

items.name: Whispers of Niflheim
items.flavour: A strange object from which mischievous whispers can faintly be heard... Instantly teleports the user to Kirkena's Secret Room.

items.name: Mother's Nightmare
items.flavour: A mother's nightmares that have been given physical form. Very rare.

items.name: Broken Hieroglyph
items.flavour: A broken tablet bearing partial, and thus illegible hieroglyphic writing. Not that you could read it if it wasn't broken.

items.name: Old Hilt
items.flavour: An old hilt broken off the cursed sword Executioner that roams Geffenia. A palpable hatred still emanates from it.

items.name: Blade Lost in Darkness
items.flavour: A blade taken from the cursed sword Mysteltainn that roams Geffenia. It seems to be absorbing the light from the world around you.

items.name: Bloody Edge
items.flavour: A broken edge from the cursed sword Tirfing that roams Geffenia. It is perpetually coated in blood that never dries.

items.name: Enchanted Key
items.flavour: A magical key created to keep something sealed at the top of the Clock Tower. Whatever it was originally supposed to be used on, it is now being used to keep the Lord of the Clock Tower trapped there.

items.name: Cursed Key
items.flavour: A magical key created to keep something sealed at the top of the Clock Tower. Originally created by the Lord of the Clock Tower, it ended up becoming her own downfall.

items.name: Poison Spore
effect: A clump of spores from a toxic mushroom.

items.name: Red Stocking
items.flavour: A Christmas stocking from which presents were stolen through a hole made in the bottom.

items.name: Matchstick
effect: A phosphorus tipped stick that can be used to start a fire.

items.name: Shining Sand
effect: A handful of sand with a supernatural sparkle, like a pile of tiny diamonds, produced by the ants of Ant Hell
Maybe there is some use for it in Ant Hell 2...?

items.name: Alice's Apron
items.flavour: An apron worn by Alice. Her movements are so lifelike, it's hard to believe she's only a mechanical doll.

items.name: Gryphon Talon
items.flavour: A razor sharp talon pried from the foot of a gryphon roaming the grasslands of Arunafeltz.

items.name: Cyfar
items.flavour: A strange blue crystal formed in the bodies of some monsters.

items.name: Brigan
items.flavour: A red mineral commonly found in the ruins of Glast Heim. It's not clear what causes this mineral to form, but considering the environment there, it can't be anything good.

items.name: Soft Feather
items.flavour: A feather taken from the owls that infest Thanatos Tower. It's remarkably soft, given that it came from such an obviously evil creature.

items.name: Sea-otter Fur
items.flavour: Sea otter fur that is soft and downy enough to be used in making clothing.

items.name: Ice Chunk
items.flavour: A mysterious lump of ice that wil never melt. You can probably thank Christmas Magic for this unnatural abomination.

items.name: Stone Fragment
effect: A small piece of rock from the canyons around Veins.

items.name: Burnt Wood
items.flavour: A chunk of wood that was partially burned in a stove. Considering how angry that stove was when you found it, it's pretty strange it survived in such good condition.

items.name: Destroyed Armor
items.flavour: Heavy armor plates that have been damaged beyond repair, taken from the guardian robots being tested in the secret military base in Thor's Volcano. The damage makes it hard to tell...but is that a Rekember logo...? Very rare.

items.name: Tattered Clothes
items.flavour: Worn, tattered clothing taken from some ruffian or vagabond. Not suitable for wearing.

items.name: Old Shuriken
items.flavour: An old, rusty shuriken that was well loved, if maybe not well taken care of, by a ninja turtle. Jury's out on whether it was a teenager.

items.name: Freya's Jewel
effect: A sparkling clear gemstone so beautiful it is commonly believed to have originally belonged to Freya herself.
A component of the Godly Item Brisingamen

items.name: Thor's Gauntlets
items.flavour: A pair of steel gauntlets rumored to have been worn by Thor, god of thunder, when wielding Mjolnir. Unfortunately, they're impossible to wear.

items.name: Iron Maiden
effect: An instrumen used for torture.

items.name: Wheel of the Unknown
items.flavour: A curious wheel whose actual purpose is truly mysterious. A component of the Godly Item Sleipnir.

items.name: Silver Ornament
items.flavour: A beautifully crafted ornament of pure silver. It has an almost divine quality to it. A component of the Godly Item Brisingamen.

items.name: Wrath of Valkyrie
effect: The pure rage of the Valkyries, the choosers of the slain, that has been condensed into physical form.
A component of the Godly Item Hervor Alvitr

items.name: Angelic Feather
items.flavour: A feather radiating holy power. When you hold it in your hands, you can't help but feel drawn to the Payon Forest...

items.name: Cat Tread
effect: The sound of cat footsteps that has been materialized into physical form.
A component of the Godly Item Megingjard

items.name: Woman's Moustache
effect: Facial hair purported to come from a woman, something thought to be lost to the world for all time.
A component of the Godly Item Megingjard

items.name: Living Stone
items.flavour: A fragment of stone rich in vital energy. It appears to still be trying to grow.

items.name: Spirit of Fish
items.flavour: A transparent blue bottle that contains the spirit of a fish. It looks very beautiful with it's transparent blue color. A component of the Godly Item Sleipnir.

items.name: Sputum of Bird
items.flavour: A bottle containing bird sputum, a very rare item considering that birds do not salivate. A component of the Godly Item Megingjard.

items.name: Sinew of Bear
items.flavour: A small bunch of amazingly rare bear sinew. A component of the Godly Item Megingjard.

items.name: Emblem of the Sun
items.flavour: A small golden bead possessed by the Herald of Dawn. It constantly shines with the brilliant light of the rising sun. Very rare.

items.name: Breath of Spirit
items.flavour: Breath exhaled by a departed soul that has somehow managed to persist in the material realm. A component of the Godly Item Sleipnir.

items.name: Flawless Snow Crystal
effect: A piece of crystallized snow, perfect in beauty both aesthetic and mathematical.
A component of the Godly Item Brisingamen

items.name: Omen of Tempest
effect: A strange orb that can be used to predict when windstorms will occur.
A component of the Godly Item Hervor Alvitr

items.name: Ripple
items.flavour: A conic receptacle that contains a single ripple from the ocean.

items.name: Billow
effect: A sculpture of a raging tidal wave that looks so lifelike, you wouldn't be surprised if it burst into motion at any moment.
A component of the Godly Item Hervor Alvitr

items.name: Drifting Air
items.flavour: A gorgeous sculpture made by an artist who claimed to be able to sense forms within the drifting air. A component of the Godly Item Sleipnir.

items.name: Cogwheel
items.flavour: A cogwheel taken from the heart of the massive mining machine lost deep in the Einbech Mines. You can only imagine what incredible progress it could have achieved if kept out of the hands of those Pitmen. Very rare.

items.name: Alloy Fragment
items.flavour: A broken metal fragment made from an unknown alloy. You've never seen this metal elsewhere, but it seems remarkably prevalent in Verus.

items.name: Solidified Lava
items.flavour: A chunk of lava that has, luckily for you, cooled down enough to be safe to the touch.

items.name: Burning Heart
items.flavour: A heart of enchanted stone that emits an otherworldly flame at all times. Very rare.

items.name: Live Coal
items.flavour: A live coal that never seems to burn out, no matter how long you leave it.

items.name: Ancient Magic Scroll
items.flavour: A tattered, ancient scroll inscribed with formulas for dark, forbidden magics. For better or worse, it is too damaged to learn much from it. Very rare.

items.name: Goat Horn
items.flavour: A sturdy and razor sharp horn taken from the greatest of wild goats. Wait, were that goat's horns actually this straight...?

items.name: Goat Skin
effect: Skin and hair taken from a wild goat.

items.name: Broken Shield Piece
effect: A fragment of the shield used by the Lord of the Dead.

items.name: Shining Spear Blade
items.flavour: A shining spearhead that was once used by the Lord of the Dead. Unfortunately it no longer possesses the immense power to take lives it once had. Very rare.

items.name: Rusted Sword
effect: An old sword damaged by prolonged exposure to sea water.

items.name: Sharp Paper
items.flavour: Incredibly sharp and stout paper that looks sturdy enough to be used as a knife.

items.name: Pharaoh's Scepter
mastery: Magical Attunement mastery: Variable Cast Time -2%
effect: If refine level is below 5, Fixed Cast Time -0.5s
If refine level is above 5, All Element Magic Damage +10%
items.flavour: The scepter wielded by an ancient king from an unknown civilization that seems to predate Morroc's. You can only wonder what led to their demise if they had magics as powerful as those seen in this staff.

items.name: Pharaoh's Mask
items.flavour: A golden mask worn by the ancient king sealed deep within the Sphinx. Morroc's ancient rulers all seemed to succeed in their quest for immortality, but what did it cost them? Very rare.

items.name: Hill Wind Talon
effect: A Talon from a Hill Wind.

items.name: Torn Magic Book
items.flavour: A tattered old book whose pages are crammed full of forbidden dark magics. Or you assume, as it's written in a language you can't read. Very rare.

items.name: Torn Scroll
items.flavour: A torn piece of scroll that once bore knowledge used to keep whatever was sealed under the Clock Tower in check.

items.name: Grave Dust
items.flavour: Dust collected from inside the Capitolina Catacombs. Contains faint traces of an otherworldly power.

items.name: Burning Horseshoe
items.flavour: A burning horseshoe. Should probably only be shod on a burning horse.

items.name: Burning Hair
items.flavour: Bundled scraps of intensely hot fibers that look much like a clump of hair.

items.name: Large Jellopy
items.flavour: A massive jellopy left behind by the true master of all porings. Feels very at home in Payon Forest.

items.name: Yggdrasil's Dew
items.flavour: Morning dew gathered from the Yggdrasil tree. It glimmers faintly with the gentle light of life.

items.name: Piece of Bamboo
items.flavour: A piece of bamboo from a bamboo tree, an otherwise rare plant that grows in great abundance in Amatsu.

items.name: Worn-out Kimono
items.flavour: A beautiful kimono styled after the clothing worn in ancient Amatsu.

items.name: Cursed Shuriken
items.flavour: A broken and cursed shuriken once wielded by the ghostly Ninja haunting the heart of the Amatsu Shrine. You don't know the nature of the grudge that old ghost bore, but you can still feel its malice emanating from this relic.

items.name: Dark Mask
items.flavour: A dark mask used to cover the face and conceal the identity of the wearer, made famous by its use by the Amatsu Clan's precursors.

items.name: Broken Urn
items.flavour: A broken urn that once contained the remains of an ancient person. Whatever power drew those remains out of it still lingers inside...

items.name: Tengu Mask
items.flavour: A mask in the form of a long, and frankly rather ugly, red nose worn by Tengu deep in the Amatsu Shrine.

items.name: Giant Butterfly Wing
effect: A gigantic wing from a dangerous jungle butterfly.

items.name: False God's Emblem
items.flavour: A talisman carried by the evil spirit that attempted to take the remnants of the Serpentine Temple for itself. Though it failed, it's servants still linger, futilely attempting to finish their master's work. Very rare.

items.name: Warden's Claw
items.flavour: A sharp claw taken from the werewolf guarding the entrance to the Kamidal Mountains. Though it was exceptionally aggressive, it had a strangely human look in its eyes...

items.name: Divine Core
items.flavour: A crystalline core forged from shards of divine light made to contain and control the power of the gods. A key ingredient in the creation of Godly Items.

items.name: Piano Key
items.flavour: A white key which was came from a broken piano found hidden in Niflheim. Kirkena the Witch was looking for these.

items.name: Wooden Heart
items.flavour: An artificial wooden heart that once gave life to a Wooden Golem. It still feels full of energy.

items.name: Savanna Grass
items.flavour: A soft but hardy blade of grass plucked from the grasslands surrounding Arunafeltz.

items.name: Jungle Vine
items.flavour: A sturdy length of vine commonly found in the Umbala Jungle.

items.name: Jungle Leaf
effect: A huge leaf native to the Umbala Jungle.

items.name: Enchanted Log
items.flavour: A wooden log from a tree that refuses to burn, no matter how much heat it is subjected to.

items.name: Strong Branch
items.flavour: A sturdy tree branch found in the Splendide area. A bit strange that these are so common, as there aren't actually that many trees in Splendide...

items.name: Rusty Kitchen Knife
effect: A dull edged, rusty kitchen knife stained with blood.

items.name: Broken Inscription
items.flavour: A broken piece of stone with writing carved in an otherworldly language. You can only wonder what it describes...or where it came from.

items.name: Broken Needle
items.flavour: Pieces of a sewing needle that have broken in two. Something about this needle feels off...like it's somehow aware of you.

items.name: Decomposed Rope
items.flavour: A length of old, rotten rope that was once used to hang something decidedly unpleasant, judging by the reddish brown stains still lingering on it.

items.name: Gold Ore
items.flavour: A lump of...let's call it ore, that seems to contain some traces of actual gold.

items.name: Steel Ore
items.flavour: What do you mean there's no such thing as Steel Ore? You're looking at some right now! Maybe you should take it up with the Kobolds.

items.name: Jade Bead
items.flavour: A small bead of pure jade that looks like the eye of a cat, presented as an offering for the departed soul of the person laid to rest in the Forgotten Tomb.

items.name: Tiger Panty
items.flavour: The number of questions this item raises are too numerous to fit in a mere item description box. Very rare. Thankfully.

items.name: Nursing Bottle
items.flavour: Milk that is bottled for infants. Though considering where you got this one, you probably shouldn't try giving it to one.

items.name: Rose Quartz
items.flavour: A rare pink mineral that was once prized by the Zealotus of the Glast Heim Prison. You can only imagine where she got something so pretty while living in such a dismal place. Very rare.

items.name: Citrin
items.flavour: A rare mineral with a yellow, jewel-like sheen. Symbolizes communicative conversation and mental calm.

items.name: Pyroxene
items.flavour: A group of crystalline silicate mineral common in igneous and metamorphic rocks. Symbolizes cure and restoration.

items.name: Rare Gemstone
items.flavour: A clump of ore containing rare, unnatural gemstones. Were these produced by Tao Gunka, or did it bring them here from...wherever it came from? Very rare.

items.name: Sessrumnir Emblem
items.flavour: An emblem given only to the greatest warriors of the Sessrumnir Temple. For an adventurer to even possess one of these emblems is the greatest blasphemy. The Veins Rebels would lavishly reward anyone capable of handing this token over to them.

items.name: Obsidian Fragment
effect: A sharp, shiny fragment broken off a dark crystal.

items.name: Ungoliant Leg
items.flavour: A huge leg taken from a massive insect roaming the Einbroch Fields.

items.name: Old Pick
items.flavour: An old, worn out pick that had been picked up by monsters to do...whatever monsters do when there are no adventurers around.

items.name: Dust Pollutant
items.flavour: A clump of small, dry particles that can commonly be found clinging to just about anything in the Einbroch area.

items.name: Captured Gas
items.flavour: Captured gas from a living Pollution Elemental. You can only imagine what kind of havoc it would wreak if you opened this bag.

items.name: Kraken's Leg
items.flavour: A squirming tentacle from the massive sea monster that once lived in the depths of Byalan Dungeon. Very rare.

items.name: Revenant's Eye
items.flavour: A sinister red jewel carried by the cultists that sometimes pop up in the ruins of Glast Heim. You can only imagine what would draw someone to such a desolate place.

items.name: Will of the Darkness
items.flavour: A dark oval stone with seven red eyes that still move to observe their surroundings. You're not sure it's actually safe to hold onto this.

items.name: Old Pendant
items.flavour: An old pendant found in a very ominous place, carried by a very inauspicious creature. It's hard to guess what significance this particular item has, but you can't imagine it's good.

items.name: Broken Handcuffs
items.flavour: A pair of metal restraints which still seem to smell of blood. For better or worse, they are broken beyond repair.

items.name: False Heart Fragment
items.flavour: An object that appears almost identical to one of the Ymir Heart Fragments, incredible artifacts that contain unimaginable power. The disturbing energy emanating from this one makes it clear it is an imitation, though it is still dangerously powerful. Very rare.

items.name: Research Chart
items.flavour: A chart showing numerous graphs and statistics about secret projects being carried out in the Somatology Laboratory. Unfortunately its written entirely in code, so you can't make heads or tails of anything it says.

items.name: ID Card
items.flavour: A small identification card belonging to security workers in Rekember's secret Somatology Laboratory.

items.name: Blue Crest Piece
items.flavour: A colored piece of metal that seems to make up a small part of a larger whole.

items.name: Green Crest Piece
items.flavour: A colored piece of metal that seems to make up a small part of a larger whole.

items.name: Orange Crest Piece
items.flavour: A colored piece of metal that seems to make up a small part of a larger whole.

items.name: Red Crest Piece
items.flavour: A colored piece of metal that seems to make up a small part of a larger whole.

items.name: Crystal of Hatred
items.flavour: Negative emotion condensed and crystallized into a physical form. Morroc's hatred for all living things knew no bounds.

items.name: Crystal of Sorrow
items.flavour: Negative emotion condensed and crystallized into a physical form. Every broken heart from Morroc's rampage only served to fuel his power.

items.name: Crystal of Despair
items.flavour: Negative emotion condensed and crystallized into a physical form. Morroc's name alone was enough to smother the hopes and dreams of those in his path.

items.name: Crystal of Agony
items.flavour: Negative emotion condensed and crystallized into a physical form. Not even those who died to Morroc's rampage knew relief, their souls tormented even in the afterlife.

items.name: Crystal of Darkness
items.flavour: Negative emotion condensed and crystallized into a physical form. The endless darkness within it is a perfect reflection of Satan Morroc's vision for Midgard. Very rare.

items.name: Fragment of Agony
items.flavour: A fragment of a green jewel that emanates feelings of irrepressible pain.

items.name: Fragment of Sorrow
items.flavour: A fragment of a purple jewel that emanates feelings of irrepressible misery.

items.name: Fragment of Hatred
items.flavour: A fragment a blue jewel that emanates feelings of irrepressible hostility.

items.name: Fragment of Despair
items.flavour: A fragment of an orange jewel that emanates feelings of irrepressible hopelessness.

items.name: Crimson Feather
items.flavour: A large feather with a sinister red gleam. You can't help but feel that the "angel" it came from was anything but.

items.name: Dragon's Head
items.flavour: The severed head of a terrifying dragon guarding the heart of the Abyss Lake. It almost feels like it is still glaring angrily at you.

items.name: Treasure Chest
items.flavour: A treasure box filled with old coins, ornaments and jewelry plundered from ancient and unknown kingdoms. Very rare.

items.name: Fire Dragon Scale
items.flavour: A pristine, fully intact scale taken from the body of Detardeurus. Though quite solid, it doesn't seem these scales were the secret to his strange immortality. Very rare.

items.name: Keycard Alpha
items.flavour: A flat, translucent yellow keycard. You can only guess it's used to unlock something in the Black Ops Base.

items.name: Vermillion Keycard
items.flavour: A flat, translucent red keycard with no obvious markings on it to indicate where it should be used. Something about the colour leaves a somewhat sinister impression on you.

items.name: Steel Fragment
items.flavour: A bizarre piece of steel found on the Perfected Robots in Kiel Hyre's secret lair. You're not sure how, but it seems this small fragment is what gave them such incredible new powers.

items.name: Mechanical Device
items.flavour: A complex mechanical device developed in Kiel Hyre's Robot Factory. Its true function and purpose is a mystery.

items.name: Keycard Omega
items.flavour: A flat and transparent black keycard. You can only guess it's used to unlock something in the Black Ops Base.

items.name: Broken Iron
items.flavour: A chunk of broken iron retrieved from a destroyed autonomous robot. Despite its cute little eyes, you're pretty sure it wasn't sentient.

items.name: Prismatic Keycard
effect: Very rare.

items.name: Valhalla's Flower
items.flavour: A mysterious flower that only grows in Valhalla, the Hall of the Slain. You feel like the fact Randgris carried this flower with her might speak something about her character. Very rare.

items.name: Rune of Darkness
items.flavour: A dark rune with ancient writing engraved inside it. It possesses a mysterious power, but one you can't quite understand.

items.name: Burnt Part
items.flavour: A burnt out piece of machinery from one of the exceptionally advanced robots built in the Robot Factory.

items.name: Veins Token
effect: A medal crafted from an ostensibly valuable metal that the Veins Military hands out in great amounts to those who support their cause.
Account Bound

items.name: Condensed Darkness
items.flavour: A dark, glassy ball left behind by the cosmic entities inhabiting the top levels of the Astral Tower.

items.name: Glacial Heart
items.flavour: A heart made of pure ice that once beat at the heart of a massive Ice Titan. It still pulses with frigid energy.

items.name: Ice Scale
items.flavour: A thin scale made of ice taken from the great Ice Salamander Ktullanux. It was said he was once tasked by the Sessrumnir Temple to guard one of their darkest secrets, but now it seems he guards something much more dangerous... Very rare.

items.name: Bloody Rune
items.flavour: A glowing, blood red rune with ancient writing engraved inside it. It possesses a mysterious power, but one you can't quite understand.

items.name: Rotten Flesh
items.flavour: A piece of rotten flesh that, against all common sense, still seems to be alive...at least, in some sense of the word.

items.name: Sticky Poison
items.flavour: A sticky, poisonous fluid common to the plants and animals that inhabit the outskirts of the Serpentine Temple.

items.name: Will of Red Darkness
items.flavour: A large red stone with seven eyes that track your movement. Maybe it's just your imagination, but they seem to look...hungry? Very rare.

items.name: Suspicious Hat
items.flavour: A large, pointy hat that entirely conceals the identity of its wearer, which was once worn by one of the fanatics that had been possessed by the demon haunting the Rachel Sanctuary.

items.name: White Mask
items.flavour: An unnerving white mask worn by the fanatics sealed away in the Rachel Sanctuary. Did the dark forces in the Sanctuary drive them mad, or did it take advantage of a madness that was already there...?

items.name: Freezing Snow Powder
items.flavour: Powdered snow infused with a remarkable ice magic even more powerful than that which keeps the Ice Dungeon frozen.

items.name: Fox Emblem
effect: A small emblem in the shape of a fox mask.
Very rare.

items.name: Talisman of Rebirth
effect: Effect: Revives KO'ed character
items.flavour: A talisman imbued with miraculous powers that allows for the dead to cross back through the Veil and return to life of their own accord.

items.name: Bloody Coin
items.flavour: A cursed old coin that always seems to be coated in fresh blood, no matter how often it is cleaned.

items.name: Lost Letter
items.flavour: ...nothing broke my heart more than having to leave without saying goodbye to you. And so, though I know I have no way of getting it to you, I've written this letter so that maybe, just maybe, I can tell you how much I loved you, and how much I still do. I've written this letter a thousand times, and I'll write a thousand more if I have to. And someday, if God has any mercy at all, one of these thousands of letters will make its way to you...

items.name: Robotic Core Fragment
items.flavour: A piece taken from the destroyed core of a highly advanced robot. It's not clear whether human technology will ever advance to this level again. Very rare.

items.name: Old White Cloth
items.flavour: A worn-out piece of white clothing once worn by the civilians that populated Nameless Island. It's in remarkably good shape considering what happened to the person wearing it.

items.name: Clattering Skull
items.flavour: A remarkably intact skull taken from the zombies populating Nameless Island. So intact, in fact, that it occasionally starts moving again.

items.name: Broken Farming Implement
items.flavour: A damaged piece of farm equipment that was once used by the civilians living on Nameless Island.

items.name: Broken Crown
items.flavour: A broken crown that once belonged to the monarch of a very familiar kingdom. But what was he...or rather, his corpse, doing on Nameless Island...?

items.name: Sealed Grimoire
items.flavour: A grimoire that no doubt contains all sorts of heretical and blasphemous teachings...but whatever dark magic was used to seal it, you can't find a way to get it open.

items.name: String
items.flavour: A piece of string used to tie rice dumplings together so they don't fall apart.

items.name: Red Signet Ring
items.flavour: A red signet ring belonging to one of the member's of Thanatos Tower's ceremonial guard, a symbol for those with tireless dedication.

items.name: Green Signet Ring
items.flavour: A green signet ring belonging to one of the member's of Thantos Tower's ceremonial guard, a symbol for those with unmatched ferocity.

items.name: Emblem of Valor
items.flavour: An emblem signifying one has overcome great hardship, and has earned the right to battle against impossible odds for even greater glory. Required for the summoning of Challenge Mode MVPs.

items.name: Goddess Tear
items.flavour: A beautifully resplendent jewel, said to have been dedicated to the goddess Freya by the master jeweller who cut it, unable to believe the magnificence wrought by his own hand. A component of the Godly Item Brisingamen.

items.name: Valkyrie's Token
items.flavour: A small sculpture made to venerate the Valkyries, the maidens of war that serve the Aesir. A component of the Godly Item Brynhild.

items.name: Valkyrian Armor Fragment
items.flavour: A fragment of metal taken from the armor of one of Odin's Valkyries. Despite its damaged state, it is still infused with tremendous divine power. A component of the Godly Item Brynhild.

items.name: Hero's Remains
items.flavour: The ashes of a hero so legendary that his remains are still treated with respect, even though his name has been forgotten for centuries. A component of the Godly Item Brynhild.

items.name: Andvari's Ring
items.flavour: A ring that once belonged to the dwarf Andvari, which was held captive by the dragon Fafnir for a great period of time. A component of the Godly Item Brynhild.

items.name: Dusk Glow
effect: The essence of the setting sun condensed into physical form.
A component of the Godly Item Aesprika

items.name: Dawn Essence
items.flavour: The first glimmer of dawn captured and condensed into a physical form. A component of the Godly Item Aesprika.

items.name: Cold Moonlight
items.flavour: Pure and gentle moonlight collected and condensed into a physical form. A component of the Godly Item Aesprika.

items.name: Hazy Starlight
items.flavour: Shimmering light woven from the all the stars of night condensed into a physical form. A component of the Godly Item Aesprika.

items.name: Crystal Key
items.flavour: A small, crystalline key found in the Path of Ascension in Okolnir.

items.name: Valkyrie's Gift
effect: A flower said to have been given as a gift from a valkyrie to a mortal man.
A component of the Godly Item Brynhild

items.name: Poison Herb Nerium
items.flavour: An extremely rare and extremely toxic plant. Cultivating it is illegal in most nations.

items.name: Poison Herb Rantana
items.flavour: An extremely rare and extremely toxic plant. Cultivating it is illegal in most nations.

items.name: Poison Herb Makulata
items.flavour: An extremely rare and extremely toxic plant. Cultivating it is illegal in most nations.

items.name: Poison Herb Seratum
items.flavour: An extremely rare and extremely toxic plant. Cultivating it is illegal in most nations.

items.name: Poison Herb Scopolia
items.flavour: An extremely rare and extremely toxic plant. Cultivating it is illegal in most nations.

items.name: Poison Herb Amoena
items.flavour: An extremely rare and extremely toxic plant. Cultivating it is illegal in most nations.

items.name: Light Granule
items.flavour: A golden crystal that shines like sunlight given a physical form.

items.name: Ancient Hair Ornament
effect: A hair accessory, said to have been worn by an ancient queen. Whoever it once belonged to, it found its way to Maya Purple.
Maybe there is some use for it in Ant Hell 2...?

items.name: Wild Flower
effect: Pet: Orc Warrior
items.flavour: A wildflower whose scent is so nice that even the most savage of warriors will admit to enjoying its fragrance.

items.name: Guardian's Bell
items.flavour: A golden bell that once adorned the body of the great serpent guarding the Serpentine Temple. Very rare.

items.name: Red Scarf
items.flavour: A stylish crimson muffler that will make you the envy of alligators everywhere. So it's probably best you don't try and wear it.

items.name: Cursed Water
items.flavour: A vial containing cursed water that can be found all over Geffenia. Even thousands of years after its collapse, the curse that destroyed that nation still runs strong.

items.name: Relic Box
effect: Effect: Gives 1 random MVP Summoning Relic
items.flavour: An ornate box that contains a single MVP Relic. No way of knowing what it is until you open it!

items.name: Tropical Sograt
effect: Increases a random stat by 3 for 10 minutes
Over-indulging may have negative consequences...
items.flavour: A delicious alcoholic beverage made with exotic fruits found only in Morocc.

items.name: Vermilion on the Beach
effect: Increases a random stat by 5 for 10 minutes
Over-indulging may have negative consequences...
items.flavour: A scarlet colored cocktail, favored by the ladies, that gives the drinker the feeling of lounging on the beach.

items.name: Battle Manual
effect: [Testing Item]
Increases EXP gain by 500% for 30 Minutes
This item is not consumed on use

items.name: Bubble Gum
effect: [Testing Item]
Increases Drop Rates by 500% for 30 Minutes
This item is not consumed on use

items.name: Convex Mirror
effect: A clean glass mirror that can be used to detect the positions of Champion class monsters.
The effect lasts for 5 minutes, until the user leaves the map, or until the user disconnects.
If there is no Champion monster on the current map, the mirror will disappear with no effect.

items.name: Badge of Authority
items.flavour: A badge that symbolized the authority of the Emperor, given to those who executed his will. A person bearing this was to be treated with the same respect as the ruler who sent them. Very rare.

items.name: Novice Magnifier
effect: Effect: Identify unknown item
items.flavour: A magnifying glass used for appraises unidentified items and equipment. Use [Ctrl + Right Click] directly on an unknown item to identify it.

items.name: Tantan Noodles
items.flavour: A bowl of tasty noodles that seems to be a favorite of the spirit of the young girl guarding the upper level of the Forgotten Tomb.

items.name: Nine Tail
effect: Effect: LUK +10
Rental duration: 30 minutes
items.flavour: A rare specialty dish from Payon that bestows luck on those fortunate enough to eat it.

items.name: Veins Butterfly Wing
effect: An enchanted butterfly's wing given to adventurers loyal to Veins and the Revolutionary Army.
Immediately teleports the user to Veins.
(This item is not consumed on use)
This item is Account Bound

items.name: Rachel Butterfly Wing
effect: An enchanted butterfly's wing given to adventurers loyal to Rachel and the Sessrumnir Temple.
Immediately teleports the user to Rachel.
(This item is not consumed on use)
This item is Account Bound

items.name: Novice Card Album
items.flavour: A small folder which isn't useful as a weapon, but can at least hold some cards for you.

items.name: Intermediate Card Album
items.flavour: A small folder with an additional page, capable of holding more cards than your average album.

items.name: Master Card Album
items.flavour: A small folder with plenty of extra pages, allowing you to hold quite a few cards at once.

items.name: Ashen Blood
effect: Required for Fatal Blades and Thirsting Fangs Level 3
Poison Status Damage is increased by 10% of the user's bonuses to Bleeding and Burning Damage per level
items.flavour: A powerful toxin crafted specifically for and by Guillotine Crosses. Victims experience the agonizing sensation of all the blood in their body igniting within them.

items.name: Reaper's Touch
effect: Required for Fatal Blades and Thirsting Fangs Level 5
Reduces the time between damage ticks for Poison and Deadly Poison by 100ms per level
items.flavour: A powerful toxin crafted specifically for and by Guillotine Crosses. This exceptionally powerful toxin kills faster than any other poison.

items.name: Plague Thirst
effect: Required for Fatal Blades and Thirsting Fangs Level 4
Whenever Poison or Deadly Poison inflict damage, they have a 5% chance per level to spread to all enemies within 1 cell of the original victim per level
items.flavour: A powerful toxin crafted specifically for and by Guillotine Crosses. It becomes highly contagious, spreading to anyone unfortunate enough to approach the victim.

items.name: Black Haze
effect: Required for Fatal Blades and Thirsting Fangs Level 2
Poison and Deadly Poison also inflict the Blind Status.
Poison Status Damage inflicted is increased by 20% of the user's Blind Potency per level
items.flavour: A powerful toxin crafted specifically for and by Guillotine Crosses. It robs its victims of their sight as much as their life.

items.name: Endless Infection
effect: Required for Fatal Blades and Thirsting Fangs Level 1
Increases the duration of Poison and Deadly Poison inflicted by the user by 1 second per level
items.flavour: A powerful toxin crafted specifically for and by Guillotine Crosses. It is engineered to resist the body's attempts at ridding itself of the poison.

items.name: Raw Runestone
effect: A piece of raw runestone with weak mystical power. A Rune Knight might be able to process this into a usable form.
Used to make Tier 2 Runes

items.name: Ancient Runestone
effect: A remarkable piece of runestone infused with incredible mystical power. A Rune Knight might be able to process this into a usable form.
Used to make Tier 4 Runes

items.name: Flawless Runestone
effect: A flawless piece of runestone that overflows with unbelievable mystical power. A Rune Knight might be able to process this into a usable form.
Used to make Tier 5 Runes

items.name: Rough Runestone
effect: A rough piece of runestone that barely contains any mystical power. A Rune Knight might be able to process this into a usable form.
Used to make Tier 1 Runes

items.name: Strong Runestone
effect: A solid piece of runestone that contains a fair amount of mystical power. A Rune Knight might be able to process this into a usable form.
Used to make Tier 3 Runes

items.name: Dawn Blossom
items.flavour: A vibrant pink flower that blooms only in the vicinity of the Tower of the Morning in Eclage.

items.name: Dawn Grass
items.flavour: A lush green he rb that blooms only in the vicinity of the Tower of the Morning in Eclage.

items.name: Flash Dagger
effect: Increases the duration of First Art by 10 Seconds
Str +1 per Refine
If Refined to at least +7: Melee Damage +10%
items.flavour: A short bladed knife that seems to constantly crackle with electric energy, making it slash and stab with lightning speed.

items.name: Usurper's Fang
effect: Poison Property
Defense Pierce +1% per 2 Base Agi
items.flavour: A wicked dagger once used by those who enshrined a false god in the remnants of the Serpentine Temple. The natural world recoils at its touch.

items.name: Khukri
effect: Melee Damage +1% per Refine
Ranged Damage +1% per Refine
Magic Attack +1% per Refine
items.flavour: A small blade rumored to harbor the grudge of a black dragon.

items.name: Jitte
effect: Damage Taken from All Races -10%
items.flavour: A small hooked blade that is intended for use in intercepting an enemy's attacks more than dealing damage itself.

items.name: Kamaitachi
effect: Defense Pierce +30%
MDef Pierce +30%
items.flavour: A dagger that glides through enemies like a piercing wind, delivering fatal blows through any armor or magical protection.

items.name: Asura
items.flavour: A small dagger with weak magical properties designed for ease of use over strength.

items.name: Murasame
effect: A dagger with a razor sharp edge said to be able to cut even the air.
items.flavour: Melee attacks have a chance to inflict the Bleeding status. Ranged attacks have a chance to inflict the Vulnerable status. Magic attacks have a chance to inflict the Blind status.

items.name: Hakujin
effect: All Element Magic Damage +3% per Refine
If Refine to at least +7: Magic Pierce +30%
Combo (Hakujin + Shadow Kunai): All Magic Damage is converted to Dark Property
Combo (Hakujin + Blessed Kunai): All Magic Damage is converted to Holy Property
items.flavour: A gleaming white dagger used by the elite shinobi of the Amatsu Clan. Only true masters of Ninjutsu can draw out its full power.

items.name: Moonlight Sword
effect: MaxSP +10%
Regain 3 SP with each attack.
Weapon Level: 4
Refineable: No
Swordman, Magician, Archer, Merchant, Thief, and Ninja classes
items.flavour: Rental Item A dagger imbued with lunar spirit and the power to drain an enemy's soul.

items.name: Tooth Blade
effect: If equipped in the Main Hand: Physical Damage to Bleeding, Burning, and Poisoned enemies +1% per Refine
If Refined to +7 or higher: Bleeding, Burning, and Poison Damage +30%
If equipped in the Off Hand: Damage taken from Bleeding enemies -3% per Refine
If Refined to +7 or higher: Counter Slash inflicts Bleeding for 5 seconds
items.flavour: A remarkably sharp scalpel ostensibly used for dental work, though the fact it was found in the Nameless Island Monastery leads you to believe it may have been put to more sinister work recently.

items.name: Prinsense Knife
effect: Item For Brave Guild Adventurers.
+50% Damage.
Weapon Level: 1
Swordman, Magician, Archer, Merchant, Thief, and Ninja classes

items.name: Dragon Fang
effect: If equipped in the Main Hand: Physical and Magical Damage to Burning enemies +5%, plus an additional 1% per refine
If equipped in the Off Hand: Critical Hits ignore 10% of the enemy's Defense, plus an additional 2% per Refine.
items.flavour: A vicious dagger stolen from the dragons' hoard in the depths of the Abyss Lake. Though not literally crafted from their fangs, it still seems to possess an edge sharper than what ordinary steel should be capable of.

items.name: Assassin Dagger
effect: Envenom and Flashing Steel have a chance to inflict Bleeding
Chance: 50% + 10% per skill level
Poison Duration on Envenom -10s
items.flavour: A dagger used by an ancient sect of assassins. It is hard to say whether they eschewed the use of poisons out of principle or simply out of lack of access.

items.name: Desert Twilight
effect: If Equipped in the Main Hand: Damage to Vulnerable Enemies +3% per Refine
If Equipped in the Off Hand: Blind Potency +20
Combo (Desert Twilight + Sandstorm): Desert Blades Level +1 for every 2 Refines on the set
items.flavour: One of a pair of daggers that has been traced back to an elusive sect of Assassins that once inhabited the Arunafeltz Region. True to their nature, there are no clues as to what happened to them...or if they ever disappeared in the first place.

items.name: Sandstorm
effect: If Equipped in the Main Hand: Damage to Blind Enemies +3% per Refine
If Equipped in the Off Hand: Vulnerable Potency +20%
Combo (Desert Twilight + Sandstorm): Desert Blades Level +1 for every 2 Refines on the set
items.flavour: One of a pair of daggers that has been traced back to an elusive sect of Assassins that once inhabited the Arunafeltz Region. Their members were as vicious and unpredictable as the sandstorms of the deep desert.

items.name: Ymir's Dagger
effect: If Equipped in the Main Hand, for each Refine:
Damage to Blind and Poisoned enemies +1%
Max SP -5%
If Equipped in the Off Hand, for each Refine:
Poison Status Damage +2%
Blind Potency +2
Max SP -5%
If Refined to at least +7: Enables use of Fatal Steel Lv5
If Refined to at least +7: If already learned, increases its damage by 50% instead
items.flavour: A dagger modified by the scientists of Rekember for use by the ghostly specters that now haunt their lab. Though powerful, it is exceptionally exhausting to use, as if the designers expected its user to have a supplementary energy source.

items.name: Ivory Knife
effect: If equipped in the Main Hand: Vulnerable Potency +2% per Refine
If equipped in the Main Hand: Physical Damage to Vulnerable enemies +2% per Refine
If Refined to at least +7 in the Main Hand:
Crit Rate +25
If equipped in the Off Hand: Vulnerable Potency +2% per Refine
If equipped in the Off Hand: Damage Taken from Vulnerable enemies -2% per Refine
If Refined to at least +7 in the Off Hand:
Counter Slash inflicts the Vulnerable Status
items.flavour: A dagger carved from ivory harvested in the New World. It feels sharper than should be naturally possible.

items.name: Agony's Thorn
effect: If Equipped in the Main Hand: Damage to Poisoned enemies +2% per Refine
If Equipped in the Off Hand: Damage Taken from Poisoned enemies -3% per Refine
If Refined to at least +7: Poison Status Damage +30%
For each Diabolus item equipped: Bleeding and Burning Damage +5%
items.flavour: A jagged dagger found in the Endless Desert that seems to have some connection to Satan Morroc. It is designed to inflict as much pain on its victims as possible.

items.name: Black Wing Dagger
effect: Bleeding, Burning, and Poison Damage +10%
If Refined to +4 or higher, Additional +5%
If Refined to +7 or higher, Defense Pierce +30%
items.flavour: A cruel dagger intended to maximize the amount of pain inflicted on the target.

items.name: Ancient Dagger
effect: If Base Str is higher than both Base Dex and Base Int, Melee Damage +10%
If Base Dex is higher than both Base Str and Base Int, Ranged Damage +10%
If Base Int is higher than both Base Str and Base Dex, All Element Magic Damage +10%
items.flavour: An ancient dagger unearthed deep in the Coal Mines. Though the Kublin carried it around, it didn't seem to be what it was looking for.

items.name: Keris
effect: MATK +70
Enable a 2% chance of gaining 10% of the damage against target as HP with each attack.
An additional enchant option is available from Gatti for this weapon.
Weapon Level: 3
Base Level 30
Swordman, Magician, Archer, Merchant, Thief, and Ninja classes
items.flavour: A long time ago, the manufacturing process for the holy sword of the Jaty tribe in Dewata island disappeared, but it has been reproduced by Mastersmith Gatti again.

items.name: Saurel
effect: MATK +100
Random chance to increase ATK by 30 for 7 sec when dealing physical damage.
Random chance to increase MATK by 20 for 7 sec when dealing magical damage.
Base Level at least 100: ATK +10, MATK +10.
Weapon Level: 1
Refineable: No
Base Level 50
Swordman, Magician, Archer, Merchant, Thief, and Ninja classes
items.flavour: Rental Item A Seahorse looking fish that can be used in different cuisines it is frozen solid.

items.name: True Despair Nindo
effect: Physical and Magical Damage to All Sizes +3% per Refine
If Refined to at least +7: Mirage Duration +5s
items.flavour: A tremendous Ninja blade forged by the elite blacksmiths of the Veins Rebellion. It wields a power unlike anything seen in this world.

items.name: Fang of the Abyss
effect: If equipped in the Main Hand: Fixed Cast Time -1s
If equipped in the Main Hand: Magic Pierce +5% per Refine
If equipped in the Off Hand: Blind Potency +3 per Refine
If equipped in the Off Hand: Blind Potency Received -3 per Refine
items.flavour: A midnight black dagger bearing a curse that eats away at the souls of those it is used against.

items.name: Keris Naga
effect: Original Ancient Dagger with outstanding potential.
MATK +50
Refine Level +5: MATK +30
Refine Level +7: MATK +10
Refine Level +9: MATK +10
Weapon Level: 4
Base Level 30
Swordman, Magician, Archer, Merchant, Thief, and Ninja classes

items.name: Faceworm Leg
items.flavour: A razor sharp talon cut from a particularly large Faceworm. Unfortunately, it's not quite big enough to use as a weapon.

items.name: Faceworm Queen Leg
effect: Critical Hits gain Defense Pierce equal to your Base Int
Gain Magic Pierce equal to your Crit Rate
items.flavour: A razor sharp talon taken from a massive Faceworm. Still leaks a corrosive venom capable of piercing virtually any armor.

items.name: Six Shooter
effect: Dex +1
items.flavour: A dusty old revolver meant for last ditch efforts of self-defense.

items.name: Crimson Bolt
effect: Dex +2
ASPD +5
items.flavour: A blood-red revolver specialized in rapid firing. The color gives it a somewhat sinister feeling.

items.name: Garrison
effect: Dex +3
Rapid Shower has a chance to autocast Rapid Reload
items.flavour: A high-class pistol that used to be virtually impossible to obtain. Mass production of replicas such as this one has actually made the value of the authentic model skyrocket.

items.name: Gold Lux
effect: Atk/Matk +5%
Max HP/SP -5%
Combo (Golden Weapon + Golden Gear): All Stats +5
Combo (Golden Weapon + Golden Gear): Permanent Endure Effect
Combo (Golden Weapon + Golden Gear): Max HP/SP -15%
Combo (Golden Weapon + Golden Gear): Endure no longer provides damage reduction
items.flavour: A luxurious pistol cast from pure gold. With this, no one will ever threaten your wealth again...

items.name: Wasteland's Outlaw
effect: Dex +3
Movement Speed +10%
items.flavour: A sturdy pistol designed for use in harsh environments, where weapon maintenance isn't generally at the top of everyone's minds.

items.name: Alpha and Omega
effect: Quick Draw and Rapid Shower Damage +30%
Quick Draw inflicts the Vulnerable Status
Rapid Shower inflicts the Bleeding Status
Silences the user for 10 seconds when unequipped
items.flavour: A pair of remarkable handguns unearthed from the Juperos Ruins. As their names suggest, Gunslingers who come across these weapons rarely feel the need to pick up any other.

items.name: Iron Ally
effect: Ranged Damage +10%
If Refined to +4 or higher, additional Ranged Damage +5%
If Refined to +7 or higher, Slow Potency +30
items.flavour: A pair of elegant handguns that are just as much at home as a dress piece as they are on the battlefield.

items.name: Cold Steel
effect: Dex +2, Agi +2
Ranged Damage +1% per refine
items.flavour: A remarkable revolver that exhibits incredible potential, should it be well cared for and maintained.

items.name: Nightmare Revolver
effect: Damage dealt to Nightmare Monsters +10% + 1% per refine
items.flavour: A revolver that gives off a sinister red gleam in the presence of Nightmares.

items.name: Somatology Revolver
effect: If Refined to at least +4: Atk/Matk +30%
If Refined to at least +4: Max SP -10%
If Refined to at least +7: Damage Taken from Slowed enemies -30%
If Refined to at least +7: Max SP -15%
If Refined to at least +10: All Skill Cooldowns -30%
If Refined to at least +10: Max SP -25%
items.flavour: A revolver found among the ghosts haunting Rekember's Somatology Laboratory. It boasts a tremendous power, and a tremendous curse to match.

items.name: Sweety's Handgun
effect: Dex +3
Reduce the Cooldown of Rapid Reload and Redeploy by 5 Seconds
items.flavour: An incredible handgun once owned by Captain Sweety, leader of the St. Darmain Bandits. As with the rest of his equipment, it is exceptionally high tech.

items.name: Insurgent Revolver
effect: Slow Potency +3 per Refine
Physical Damage to Bleeding and Vulnerable enemies +1% per Refine
If Refined to at least +7: Rapid Shower Cooldown -7 Seconds
items.flavour: A heavy duty revolver issued to members of the Schwarzwald Rebellion. You can only imagine how they secured the funding to produce arms like this.

items.name: Branch
effect: Dex +1
items.flavour: A worn out old rifle. Luckily these were designed with reliability in mind, so despite its age, it still functions fine.

items.name: Cyclone
effect: Dex +2
Ignore 20% of the Defense of all monsters
items.flavour: A powerful rifle that boasts great stopping power despite its simplistic design.

items.name: Dusk
effect: Dex +3
Reduce all Fixed Cast Times by 1 second
items.flavour: A professional grade firearm for those who need the stopping power of a rifle, but don't have the luxury to be patient about doling it out.

items.name: Rolling Stone

items.name: Corrupted Cap

items.name: Costume Titan's Helm

items.name: Costume Angel Wings
items.flavour: A headband adorned with what appears to be the wings of an angel.

items.name: Costume Cube Mask
effect: What? Umm...what even is this? Is this a Halloween mask?

items.name: Costume Blush
items.flavour: Bright pink make up worn on the face to make it look like you are perpetually blushing.

items.name: Costume Elven Ears
effect: A pair of fake, pointed ears that serve to fool people into thinking you are a member of a mysterious fantasy race

items.name: Costume Drooping Aliot
items.flavour: A small doll designed to look like an Aliot, one of the highly advanced robots from Kiel Hyre's Robot Factory.

items.name: Costume Wickebine's Black Cat Ears
items.flavour: An ornamental headgear fashioned in the likeness of the ears of a cat, should you for some reason wish to signal your betrayal of humanity in favor of those furry abominations from Lasagna. These ones squirm, as if they understand the sin they are being made to be a part of.

items.name: Costume Bijofnil Wings
items.flavour: A resplendent white feather worn on the head in honor of Bijofnil, the legendary bird that lives above the Yggdrassil Tree. Once a timed cash-shop exclusive, the entire population of this costume was bought out by a single gigawhale, who now gives them out as a prize to those rare few capable of beating his credit card in combat.

items.name: Costume White Cat Ears
items.flavour: An ornamental headgear fashioned in the likeness of the ears of a cat, should you for some reason wish to signal your betrayal of humanity in favor of those furry abominations from Lasagna.

items.name: Costume Scarlet Flower
items.flavour: A hairband decorated with an elegant, scarlet flower. It's beauty is only slightly marred by the knowledge of where that flower came from.

items.name: Costume Dark Winged Helm
items.flavour: An ornamental helm once worn by the ceremonial honor guard that was tasked with watching over Thanatos Tower.

items.name: Costume Neko Mimi Kafra
items.flavour: A headband modelled after the ones worn by the Kafra Employees across the world. Sadly, this one also comes with an attached pair of cat ears.

items.name: Costume Evil Wings
items.flavour: A headband adorned with what appears to be the wings of a demon.

items.name: Costume Gas Mask
items.flavour: A sturdy gas mask designed to keep toxins from the air away from your precious and fragile lungs. Unfortunately, this is just a costume, so it won't actually save you.

items.name: Costume Black Cat Ears
items.flavour: An ornamental headgear fashioned in the likeness of the ears of a cat, should you for some reason wish to signal your betrayal of humanity in favor of those furry abominations from Lasagna.

items.name: Costume Feather Hat
items.flavour: A small hat with a feather stuck in it, symbolizing the wearer's friendship with the Steel Wings.

items.name: Costume Vicious Mind Aura
items.flavour: Otherworldly steam emits from every part of your body, simulating the aura of the Test Subjects trapped within Rekember's Somatology Laboratory.

items.name: Costume Black Cat Ears Beret
items.flavour: A stylish black beret which was likely put on to hide the abominable cat ears they were seated on top of, but alas, no mere fabric is enough to conceal that crime.

items.name: Costume Kimi's Ribbon
effect: Position: Upper
items.flavour: A ribbon once worn by an ancient marionette. Despite its age, it has been impeccably cared for.

items.name: Costume Crown of Despair
items.flavour: A crown modeled after the one worn by the ultimate king of despair.

items.name: Costume Silent Executor
items.flavour: A dangerous looking facemask designed to complement the costume of the Guillotine Cross. Ever since its adoption by Evan the Horrible, leader of the Soul of Ymir guild, it has become a symbol of those who eat, breathe, and sleep PVP.

items.name: Costume Eremes Scarf
effect: Earned by Sylius by defeating the Black Ops Heartseeker in Open Beta
items.flavour: A red scarf made famous by one of the most infamous Assassin Crosses to ever live. You can only guess why he was so attached to it.

items.name: Costume Floating Skulls
items.flavour: A set of floating skulls that hover in the air around you. Once spirits tormented by the Nightmare, thanks to your efforts, they are now free to torment you.

items.name: Costume True Light
items.flavour: A shining golden halo encompasses one who faced the greatest challenges imaginable for nothing more than the thrill of the hunt.

items.name: Costume Thorny Hairband
items.flavour: A hairband made of twisted thorns and bones, reminiscent of the source of the curse tainting the Ancient Temple.

items.name: Costume Cat Ears Cape
items.flavour: A fluffy and warm scarf worn around the shoulders to protect you from cold weather. It has a hood too, but if you wore that people would see the cat ears on it, so it's not recommended.

items.name: Costume Pope Crown
items.flavour: A replica of the crown worn by the Pope of Rachel. She hasn't been seen since the start of the civil war in Arunafeltz, so it's hard to compare how accurate this is to the real thing.

items.name: Costume Cat Ears Hat
items.flavour: A small and fancy top hat which for some reason comes with an accompanying set of cat ears. If only they could be obtained separately.

items.name: Costume Thanatos Sword
items.flavour: An ornamental sword modeled after the one used by the Mage Knight Thanatos. Though not fit for combat, it gives you such an intimidating aura you might not need to do all that much fighting anymore.

items.name: Costume Shadow Aura
effect: Since it is an equipped effect, it still will be displayed even when the effect (/effect) is turned off.
Position: Garment
items.flavour: Costume equipment with whisper that appeared out of nowhere. It looks creepy, but for the whispers it seems to be a blessing to the wearer.

items.name: Pristine Faceworm Skin

items.name: Voidwalker Cloak

items.name: Costume Empyrean Wings

items.name: Servant's Hood

If Refined to at least +7: Physical and Magical Damage to Medium Size enemies +1%

items.name: Fallen Hero's Manteau
effect: Max SP +30%

items.name: Excellion Engine

items.flavour: A mysterious device crafted with technologies found in the ruins of Verus. It seems to be trying to provide power to the other Excellion pieces...

items.name: Magician's Stole

Cat Only

items.name: Hollow Boots

items.name: Abysswalker Greaves
