If Refined to at least +7: Physical Damage to All Sizes +2%
items.flavour: A heavy pair of greaves that have an otherworldly durability to them. You can be confident in your footing in any locale with these.

items.name: Frontier Boots
effect: Ranged Damage Received -5%
items.flavour: Sturdy boots designed for crossing the wasteland, allowing the user to quickly step out of harm's way.

items.name: Nightmare Card Album
effect: Physical and Magical Damage dealt to Nightmare Monsters +10% + 1% per refine
items.flavour: A tattered, worn-out card album. Despite being in terrible shape, you feel a kind of sinister energy lingering in it.

items.name: Hebian Leaf
items.flavour: A strange leaf that the Hebians always seem to carry around with them. You only ever see them around the Serpentine Temple. Are they guardians there...or invaders?

items.name: Pristine Bandage
items.flavour: An ancient but incredibly well preserved roll of bandages. Their holy power is reserved for shrouding those destined to return from the afterlife. Very rare.

items.name: Stinky Rotten Meat
items.flavour: A chunk of foul smelling meat that nonetheless seems edible to the scavengers of the Arunafeltz Savanna.

items.name: Golden Shell Fragment
items.flavour: A fragment of the carapace-like armor worn by the Scaraba Royal Guard. It's gold sheen seems to be an artistic embellishment rather than any kind of natural coloring.

items.name: Dream Fragment
items.flavour: A small piece of a dream, a tiny fragment of what could have been, dragged kicking and screaming into the real world.

items.name: Broken Gun
items.flavour: A broken handgun once used by a commando defending the Rebel Fortress in north Schwarzwald.

items.name: Chimera Sculpture
items.flavour: An idol carved in a shape reminiscent of a Chimera. You can only hope that whoever once revered this awful creature is long gone.

items.name: Mysterious Emblem
effect: An emblem representing an organization you don't recognize.

items.name: Mysterious Ore
items.flavour: A fragment of mysterious purple ore found in the heart of Thor's Volcano. It seems critical to whatever was being researched in the secret military base there.

items.name: Dried Yggdrasil Leaf
items.flavour: A dead leaf shed by the World Tree Yggdrasil. The immense lifeforce flowing through the tree means it is incredibly rare for its leaves to ever reach this state, even decades after falling from the tree.

items.name: Illusion Stone
items.flavour: A mysterious ore that forms in places where the world has distorted, though in a very different way to the Nightmare Dungeons. Could this power be the key to overcoming the Nightmare...?

items.name: Toxic Dust
items.flavour: A light, fluffy powder that can hang in the air for an extended period of time. Which is problematic, on account of how poisonous it is.

items.name: Bandit's Scarf
items.flavour: A red scarf worn by bandits to hide their identity. They all carry these around, but none of them seem to wear them...

items.name: Spent Ammo
items.flavour: Old ammunition that has already been fired, and so is no longer usable. It seems to possess special significance to the Rebellion.

items.name: Frozen Stone
items.flavour: An amalgamated stone that is so cold and hard, it is virtually indistinguishable from ice.

items.name: Eye of Frost
items.flavour: An exceedingly rare jewel guarded jealously by the abomination sealed deep in the Ice Dungeon. Very rare.

items.name: Critical Stone(Upper)
effect: Increases Critical Damage by 3%
When equipped with Critical Stone(Mid) and Critical Stone(Lower):
Increase critical damage by additionally 6%.
Aver De Dosh (mal_in01 23,113)
items.flavour: A stone that increases critical damage. Gives the following effects when compounded on a slot of an Costume Upper Headgear.

items.name: White Snake's Tear
items.flavour: A single tear shed by the great serpent deity worshipped by the original builders of the Serpentine Temple. It sparkles with a divine light. Very rare.

items.name: Wootan Token
items.flavour: A small ornament that symbolizes acceptance among the Wootan tribe. Considering how you got this, it probably won't be quite as effective anymore.

items.name: Wootan Shield Fragment
items.flavour: A fragment of the giant shield carried by the Wootan Defender. What it was defending remains largely a mystery. Very rare.

items.name: Broken Weapon
items.flavour: An ancient weapon that is so old and damaged, you can't even identify what it was supposed to be. The archaeologists in Thanatos Tower might be able to help you restore it to its original form.

items.name: Prototype Energy Core
items.flavour: A power core used to give life to the Rogue Prototype that once terrorized the Einbroch region. Very rare.

items.name: Fragment of Darkness
items.flavour: A piece of stone formed of condensed darkness, created by the lingering effects of the curse that doomed the ancient kingdom of Glast Heim. Just holding it in your hands engenders feelings of despair.

items.name: Crystallized Darkness
items.flavour: An enormous and flawless crystal said to be a condensation of the curse that destroyed the ancient kingdom of Glast Heim. Just holding it in your hands makes you feel less alive.

items.name: Enchanted Ore
items.flavour: A strange ore found only on the Bifrost that glows with a mysterious golden light.

items.name: Eye of Thor
effect: Allows travelling to mixed timelines when fused into a Bifrost Mirror Shard.
items.flavour: Legendary Crystal bearing the Mark of Thor, it directly influences the bearer's mark of Morroc to see the distorted timeline.

items.name: Eye of Vidar
effect: Allows travelling to the past when fused into a Bifrost Mirror Shard.
items.flavour: Legendary Crystal bearing the Mark of Vidar, it directly influences the bearer's mark of Morroc to see the past.

items.name: Eye of Vali
effect: Allows travelling to the future when fused into a Bifrost Mirror Shard.
items.flavour: Legendary Crystal bearing the Mark of Vali, it directly influences the bearer's mark of Morroc to see the future.

items.name: Eye of Balder
effect: Allows travelling to the end of times when fused into a Bifrost Mirror Shard.
items.flavour: Legendary Crystal bearing the Mark of Balder, it directly influences the bearer's mark of Morroc to see the end of times.

items.name: Dragon Skull
items.flavour: A large skull taken from a dragon in the depths of the Abyss Lake Nightmare.

items.name: Dragon Bone
items.flavour: A small bone taken from the body of a dragon that was steeped in the Nightmare.

items.name: Rune of Light
items.flavour: A small, remarkably intricate and delicate orb that seems to contain holy energy.

items.name: Snake's Venom
items.flavour: A bottle of venom taken from a Hebian leader. Are the Hebians connected to the Serpentine Temple somehow? If so, why do they refuse to enter the sanctuary...?

items.name: Mantis Shell
items.flavour: The hardened shell of a mantis was mutated by exposure to tremendous levels of poison.

items.name: Damaged Circuit Board
items.flavour: A damaged circuit board from an exceptionally advanced android found in the heart of the Verus Ruins.

items.name: Purdium
items.flavour: A fragment of some kind of unidentified, jewel-like ore. You're not sure what it might be used for, but considering the effort it took to get it, you are certain it must be at least somewhat valuable.

items.name: Prismatic Jewel
items.flavour: A brilliantly shining, prismatic jewel extracted from the corpse of the Jewel Worm roaming the Kamidal Mountains.

items.name: Bradium Fragment
items.flavour: A fragment of Bradium ore, a metal unique to the New World. Unfortunately this sample has too many flaws and impurities to actually be useful.

items.name: Temporal Gemstone
items.flavour: A small gemstone born from a distortion in time and space. It seems to reject the power of the Nightmare entirely.

items.name: Heart of Corruption
items.flavour: A large jewel-like object that seems to be acting as one of the sources of Glast Heim's corruption. This particular one has fused with the Nightmare environment of Old Glast Heim's deepest level to become even more potent than it was during Glast Heim's actual fall.

items.name: Seed of Corruption
items.flavour: A small, jewel-like condensate of the corrupting magics that ultimately led to Glast Heim's fall.

items.name: Mysterious Card
effect: A card handed out by members of a mysterious organization in lieu of currency. Quite valuable, if you're friends with the right people.
Account Bound

items.flavour: The discarded shell of a creature living in the depths of the ocean.

items.name: Costume Nidhoggur Wig
items.flavour: A long flowing wig, decorated with numerous colourful flowers, modeled after the appearance of Nidhoggur when she deigns to take human form.

items.name: Costume Cheshire's Cat Ears
items.flavour: Long, soft, and fluffy ears positioned on your head to look like cat ears. Apparently modelled after some NPC in El Dicastes or something, but I can't be bothered to look them up to see if that's accurate.

items.name: Costume Ascetic's Headband
items.flavour: A headband worn by one who devoted themselves to personal perfection, cutting themselves off from civilization so they could spend their life in training.

items.name: Costume Red Cat Ears Cape
items.flavour: A fluffy and warm scarf worn around the shoulders to protect you from cold weather. It has a hood too, but if you wore that people would see the cat ears on it, so it's not recommended.

items.name: Costume White Cat Ears Hat
items.flavour: A small and fancy top hat which for some reason comes with an accompanying set of cat ears. If only they could be obtained separately.

items.name: Costume Angelic Stole
items.flavour: A pristine white scarf with a pair of angelic wings attached to the back of it. The fact that one must defeat an angel to obtain this makes you wonder whether wearing it is a sign of holiness, or the exact opposite...

items.name: Costume Brown Cat Ears Cape
items.flavour: A fluffy and warm scarf worn around the shoulders to protect you from cold weather. It has a hood too, but if you wore that people would see the cat ears on it, so it's not recommended.

items.name: Costume Princess Ribbon Crown
effect: Earned by the brave warriors of the Bossfight Cafe Guild by defeating the Archangeling in Open Beta
items.flavour: A ribbon and crown that was said to have been worn by a princess that ruled over the stars.

items.name: Costume Mecha Cat Ears
items.flavour: A pair of small mechanical triangles fashioned in the form of a cat's ears. Cat enough to prove you a traitor to humanity, but not cat enough to make you friends of the cats.

items.name: Costume Steel Mask
items.flavour: A full-faced steel helm that gives the user an exceptionally intimidating look.

items.name: Costume Witch's Cat Hat
items.flavour: A witch's hat that for some reason or other has room for cat ears on the inside.

items.name: Pure Light Spear
effect: For each refine: Damage to Vulnerable enemies +3%
For each refine: Add a 1% Chance to autocast Scouring Light on attack
For each refine: Add a 3% Chance to autocast Scouring Light on skills
If Refined to at least +9: Scouring Light Damage +30%
items.flavour: A ceremonial spear belonging to the ancient honor guard posted to watch over Thanatos Tower. Now restored to its original glory, it is a remarkably potent weapon.

items.name: Abyss Spear
effect: For each Refine: Damage to Vulnerable enemies +3%
For every two Refines: Ranged Damage +5%
For every three Refines: All Stats +1
items.flavour: A powerful spear infused with power from beyond this world. Though tainted by the Nightmare, it seems to draw its power from somewhere else.

items.name: Truesilver Spear
effect: Physical Damage to Bleeding enemies +3% per Refine
If Refined to at least +7: Bleeding Damage +30%
items.flavour: A light-weight spear forged from a unique metal found in the Scaraba Nest. Were the Scaraba drawn to those mines because of this metal, or for something else...?

items.name: Duelling Spear
effect: Melee Damage +10%
If Refined to +4 or higher, additional Melee Damage +5%
If Refined to +7 or higher, Crit Rate +20
items.flavour: A one-handed spear originally made for jousting, but eventually altered to be useful both on and off the horse.

items.name: Fortrage
effect: Each enemy killed reduces the Cooldown of Spear Flurry by 5 Seconds
Physical Damage +2% per Refine against Vulnerable enemies
items.flavour: A light-weight spear designed to be effective in cramped spaces and while fighting in tight formations.

items.name: Abyss Violin
effect: For each Refine: Ranged Damage +1.5%
For each Refine: Magic Damage to All Sizes +1.5%
For every two Refines: Increase the duration of Restorative Refrain, Quickening Chorus, Darkening Dirge, and Enervating Elegy by 0.5s
For every three Refines: All Stats +1
items.flavour: A powerful violin infused with power from beyond this world. Though tainted by the Nightmare, it seems to draw its power from somewhere else.

items.name: Abyss Blade Whip
effect: For each Refine: Ranged Damage +1.5%
For each Refine: Magic Damage to All Sizes +1.5%
For every two Refines: Increase the duration of Sinister Saunter, Wearying Waltz, Savage Stride, and Noetic Number by 0.5s
For every three Refines: All Stats +1
items.flavour: A powerful whip infused with power from beyond this world. Though tainted by the Nightmare, it seems to draw its power from somewhere else.

items.name: Antique Cello
effect: Reduces the Cooldown of Tarot Card: The Fool by 5 Seconds
Increase Physical and Magical damage to enemies under The Fool Status by 5% + 1% per Refine
Reduces the Cooldown of Melodic Mark by 2 Seconds
Increase Physical and Magical damage to enemies under Melodic Mark by 5% + 1% per Refine
items.flavour: An ancient instrument found in the depths of the Glast Heim Ruins. It remains as one of the few symbols of the old kingdom's culture beyond its ability to wage war.

items.name: Mining Gloves
effect: Defense Pierce +5%
Combo (Mining Gloves + Mining Gloves): Atk +4%
items.flavour: A pair of sturdy gloves designed to survive the harsh environment of mining deep underground.

items.name: Stargazer Ring
effect: For every 9 Base Luk, SP Consumption -2%
items.flavour: A ring infused with the power of the cosmos, granting those who wear it a taste of infinite power.

items.name: Magma's Heart
effect: Burning Damage Dealt +10%
Burning Damage Taken +10%
items.flavour: A golden brooch set with a brilliant vermillion jewel, still radiating the heat of its original home.

items.name: Fenrir's Chain
effect: Stun, Sleep, and Slow Resistance +50%
items.flavour: Large, heavy chains that were remarkably shattered by the beast they presumed to imprison. Even after the beast won its freedom, it continued to wear the broken chains as a threat to those who might try to imprison it again.

items.name: Lost King's Insignia
effect: Enables use of King's Mercy Lv1
items.flavour: An ancient insignia purportedly worn by the last king of Glast Heim. Wearing it makes you feel like responsible for the people around you.

items.name: True Morpheus's Ring
effect: Dex +3
Variable Cast Time -8%
Fixed Cast Time -0.5s
items.flavour: An ancient ring excavated from the ruins of Thanatos Tower. Restored to its original form, it now exhibits tremendous power.

items.name: True Morpheus's Bracelet
effect: Dex +3
Variable Cast Time -8%
Magic Defense Pierce +15%
items.flavour: An ancient bracelet excavated from the ruins of Thanatos Tower. Restored to its original form, it now exhibits tremendous power.

items.name: Storm Ring
effect: Wind Property Magic Damage +3%
Magical attacks ignore the elemental resistances and weaknesses of Wind Property monsters
items.flavour: A ring set with a bright green jewel, shining with the restrained power of a storm cloud.

items.name: Shield Ring
effect: Increase the strength of Barriers received by 10%
items.flavour: A ring in the shape of a shield with an enchantment that enhances defensive magics cast on the wearer.

items.name: Hollow Ring
effect: All Stats -1
For each Hollow Plate, Manteau, or Boots equipped:
ASPD +1
Fixed Cast Time -0.1s
items.flavour: A dark metal ring with a vibrant pink jewel set in it. The jewel glows ominously when you put it on your finger.

items.name: Abysswalker Ring
effect: Slow Resistance +100%
Reduce the Cooldown of Red, Orange, Yellow, and White Potions by 1 Second
items.flavour: A ring made of exceptionally sturdy metal. It hums with an otherworldly energy.

items.name: Jeweled Pendant
effect: All Stats +1
Magic Damage Received -5%
items.flavour: A pendant set with a mysteriously glowing jewel. Magic around you feels a little bit weaker while you wear it.

items.name: Abyss Revolver
effect: For each Refine: Damage to Slowed enemies +3%
For every two Refines: Slow Duration +1s
For every three Refines: All Stats +1
items.flavour: A powerful revolver infused with power from beyond this world. Though tainted by the Nightmare, it seems to draw its power from somewhere else.

items.name: Antique Revolver
effect: Attacks and Skills have a high chance to inflict Blind on the target
Attacks and Skills have a small chance to inflict Blind on the user
items.flavour: An antique black powder revolver. Despite its age it is remarkably functional, though using it generates an unreasonable amount of smoke.

items.name: Mining Saber
effect: Bleeding Damage +20%
Vulnerable Potency +20%
items.flavour: A sword with a bright red blade favored by miner's everywhere for its compact design and hard edge, capable of cleaving through flesh with ease and, should the situation call for it, stone and metal too.

items.name: Sakray's Fury
items.flavour: The wrath of Sakray, condensed into a physical, jewel-like form. Bound to the demon sword Tartaros, Sakray's fury burned hot enough to destroy not just his enemies, but everything he loved as well.

items.name: Sakray's Regret
items.flavour: The regret of Sakray, condensed into a physical, jewel-like form. Despite selling his soul to the demon sword Tartaros, Sakray failed to save those he loved. He wasn't even permitted to follow them in death.

items.name: Forbidden Scroll
items.flavour: An ancient scroll covered in mystical and esoteric writings describing the forbidden magics used by the now extinct clan of ninjas that built the Amatsu Shrine. For better or for worse, it's written in a language you don't understand. Very rare.

items.name: Mobile Storage License
items.flavour: Calls your mobile storage. Required to use the Vending skill.

items.flavour: A weapon modification created by a Mastersmith that will make any weapon it attaches to much more accurate. Though any Class can use it, it is much more effective for Mastersmiths. Using this item will overwrite the previous Random Options on the modified weapon. Cannot be applied to Relic Weapons.

items.name: Accelerating Weapon Mod
items.flavour: A weapon modification created by a Mastersmith that will make any weapon it attaches to much faster. Though any Class can use it, it is much more effective for Mastersmiths. Using this item will overwrite the previous Random Options on the modified weapon. Cannot be applied to Relic Weapons.

items.name: Critical Weapon Mod
items.flavour: A weapon modification created by a Mastersmith that will make any weapon it attaches to much more likely to land Critical Hits. Though any Class can use it, it is much more effective for Mastersmiths. Using this item will overwrite the previous Random Options on the modified weapon. Cannot be applied to Relic Weapons.

items.name: Piercing Weapon Mod
items.flavour: A weapon modification created by a Mastersmith that will make any weapon it attaches to much better at penetrating armor. Though any Class can use it, it is much more effective for Mastersmiths. Using this item will overwrite the previous Random Options on the modified weapon. Cannot be applied to Relic Weapons.

Though any Class can use it, it is much more effective for Mastersmiths. Using this item will overwrite the previous Random Options on the modified armor. Cannot be applied to Relic Armors.

items.name: Water Armor Mod

items.name: Costume Alisa Meu Pelo
effect: Earned by the brave warriors of the Senai guild by defeating the Avatar of the Serpent in Open Beta
items.flavour: A fierce and loyal tiger that will follow you everywhere you go. Go on. Give him some pets.

items.name: Costume Falling Snow
effect: Earned by the brave warriors of the Aesir Cafe guild by defeating the Black Ops Heartseeker in Open Beta
items.flavour: It's always winter when you're around, a thin layer of snow coating everything you walk past.

items.name: Costume Cinamoroll
effect: Earned by Miu of the Tea Party Guild by defeating the Avatar of the Serpent in Open Beta
items.flavour: An adorable little Cinamoroll that follows you around, cheering you on as you fight. You don't have the heart to check if it tastes like it's namesake.

items.name: Costume Cat Footprints
effect: Test
Position: Lower

items.name: Costume Jordos Cape
items.flavour: A cloak worn by the cultists of the World Serpent that built a temple for themselves in the Far North. They claimed Jormungandr turned its eyes away from you, but an uneasy feeling remains, like eyes watching you from the dark...

items.name: Costume Galaxia Helm
effect: Earned by the brave capybara Balziere by making Ornstein mad so many times during the development of both of our servers
items.flavour: A helm of black iron that has become symbolic of the infamous Galaxia.

items.name: Red Pitaya Tail

items.name: Yellow Pitaya Tail

items.name: Blue Pitaya Tail
items.flavour: The tail of a Blue Pitaya. Exceptionally rare, considering that Blue Pitayas don't exist.

items.name: Green Pitaya Tail
items.flavour: A tail cut from a Green Pitaya. It looks...and tastes strangely like a fruit.

items.name: Violet Pitaya Tail
items.flavour: A tail cut from a Violet Pitaya. It looks like a kind of fruit, but considering where it came from, it's probably too poisonous to risk tasting.

items.name: Nightmare Pitaya Tail
items.flavour: A tail left behind by the bizarre Pitaya monstrosity trapped in the altar in the Juno Fields. No traces of the dark energies powering the creature remain. Very rare.

items.name: Nightmare Fragment
effect: Decent sized fragments of crystal suffused with the distorting energies present in Nightmare Dungeons.
Required to refine Lv110 Shadow Gear

items.name: Nightmare Shard
effect: A remarkably intact shard of crystal suffused with the distorting energies present in Nightmare Dungeons.
Required to refine specialized Shadow Gear

items.name: Nightmare Chunk
effect: A large chunk of material suffused with the distorting energies present in Nightmare Dungeons.
Required to refine Lv130 Shadow Gear

items.name: Nightmare Sliver
effect: Tiny slivers charged with the distorting energies that suffuse the Nightmare Dungeons.
Required to refine Lv90 Shadow Gear

items.name: Nightmare Dust
effect: Tiny fragments, no more than dust really, that are charged with the distorting energies that suffuse the Nightmare Dungeons.
Required to refine Lv70 Shadow Gear

items.name: Nightmare Crystal
items.flavour: A crystallization of the dark, twisted energies threatening the world.

items.name: Shard of Gratitude
items.flavour: Pure, positive emotion distilled and condensed into a glassy fragment. It serves as a tangible sign of the joy and relief Sakray experienced when finally freed from the curse of the Demon Sword Tartaros.

items.name: Sealed Flame
items.flavour: A vial of enchanted glass containing a furiously burning mote of fire taken from the flame spirit sealed in the depths of Thor's Volcano. It seems to burn with purpose, but you have no idea what provoked its desire for revenge in the first place. Very rare.

items.name: Burning Jewel
items.flavour: A jewel infused with the intense heat of a volcano. This crystallization itself marks one's mastery over that fire.

items.name: Arcane Dust
items.flavour: A small pile of powder with remarkable, yet still unexplored, magical properties. Can be exchanged for rewards at the Steel Wings Headquarters in Luina.

items.name: Shadow Fragment
effect: Used for Crafting and Enhancing Tier 4 Shadow Gear.
items.flavour: A fragment broken off of a piece of powerful Shadow Gear. It's entirely unusable in its current state, but has a tremendous amount of latent potential.

items.name: Nightmare Echoes
items.flavour: A rough, gravel-like substance that is infused with the natural power of the Nightmare. Can be exchanged for rewards at the Steel Wings Headquarters in Luina.

items.name: Lost Sheet Music
items.flavour: A piece of sheet music found in the abandoned Opera House deep in Niflheim. It's written in a form of notation you aren't familiar with. Very rare.

items.name: Lab Documents
items.flavour: Research documents pilfered from Rekember's Somatology Laboratory. The Rebellion is keenly interested in these.

items.name: Shard of Despair
effect: Used by the elite smiths of the Veins Rebellion to craft highi level Weapons and Shadow Gear.
items.flavour: A fragment of pure despair that has manifested in physical form. It serves as a tangible reminder that, despite all evidence to the contrary, the Lord of the Sky Labyrinth can in fact be defeated.

items.name: Shard of Faith
effect: Used by the elite smiths of the Sessrumnir Temple to craft high level Weapons and Shadow Gear.
items.flavour: A fragment of pure faith that has manifested in physical form. Even in their state of abject apostasy, this tiny remnant of Freya's devoted followers remains.

items.name: Sanctified Oil
effect: Holy oil needed to purify false beliefs in weapons.

items.name: Sanctified Water
items.flavour: Water blessed by the "Goddess" at the heart of Rachel Sanctuary's Nightmare. Though clearly there is nothing holy about it, it still emanates an undeniable power.

items.name: Empty Darkness
items.flavour: A tiny fragment of concentrated darkness with an infinite hunger for all things. Something tells you that if you handle this poorly, it might transform back into the Shadow you took it from. Very rare.

items.name: Clock Gear
items.flavour: A bizarre set of gears from that seem to have been taken from the Clock Tower in Aldebaran. Despite being disconnected from the mechanisms of the Clock Tower, they still spin... Very rare.

items.name: Rgan Core
items.flavour: A pulsating mass taken from one of the mutated freaks in the lower levels of the Rgan Tunnels. It feels like it's still trying to grow.

items.name: Rgan Shell
effect: Type Collectible
items.flavour: A tough, flexible scale peeled off a young Rgan, one of the bizarre creatures living in the Serpentine Temple's heart. Where are they coming from? The Temple itself...?

items.name: Mutated Cell
items.flavour: A sample taken from an escaped homunculus roaming the canyons around Veins. It doesn't take much scientific knowledge to realize something bizarre had been done to the poor creature.

items.name: Transparent Scale
items.flavour: A thin, transparent scale peeled off of one of the monsters roaming the frozen canyons of the Far North.

items.name: Spindly Shell
items.flavour: A long, thin, and rigid shell collected from the strangely aggressive flora native to the Far North.

items.name: Mysterious Luminant
items.flavour: A mysterious mote of light trapped within a gel-like membrane. You have no idea what it means.

items.name: Ectoplasmic Stone
effect: Type Collectible
items.flavour: A lump of ectoplasm that has condensed and hardened into something resembling a gemstone.

items.name: Heavy Chain
effect: Type Relic
items.flavour: A heavy length of broken chain that makes a distinctly eerie sound when dragged along the floor.

items.name: Sewing Kit
effect: Type Relic
items.flavour: A small box filled with all sorts of needles and thread, useful for repairing clothing or stuffed animals.

items.name: Mutated Tentacle
effect: Type Collectible
items.flavour: A long, scaly tentacle that was once a limb of one of the Serpentine Temple's cultists. You don't know much about this cult, but it seems obvious the Temple was something they adopted, not created.

items.name: Shade Crystal
items.flavour: A crystal made of condensed death magic, evidence that the bearer was under the influence of the Death Witch sealed in Niflheim's Secret Village.

items.name: Blazing Stone
items.flavour: A fragment of stone infused with incredible heat from deep within the earth. Contains traces of an otherworldly power.

items.name: Frigid Liquid
items.flavour: A pool of exceptionally cold fluid that absolutely refuses to freeze solid.

items.name: Crystal Shard
items.flavour: A shard of crystal that once made up part of the ocular system of an ancient robot.

items.name: Dimensional Jewel Fragment
items.flavour: Shards of a broken jewel. You can sense a strange otherworldly energy among the pieces, but in this broken state, those powers are too weak to accomplish anything.

items.name: Dimensional Feather
items.flavour: A mysterious feather with obvious mystical properties. It feels like it might slip out of reality if you take your eyes off of it for too long.

items.name: Dimensional Jewel
items.flavour: A flawless jewel that hums with otherworldly energy. Just holding it makes the world around you feel less solid.

items.name: Dimensional Ornament
items.flavour: A mysterious ornament with obvious mystical properties. A cursory inspection makes it seem like it's designed to bind a number of other objects together.

items.name: Serpentine Berry
items.flavour: A strange fruit favored by the Rgan infesting the Far North Tunnels. Those who eat a lot seem to mutate faster.

items.name: Baron's Cane
items.flavour: A sturdy cane wielded by the Owl Baron that took up residence in Thanatos Tower's lower level. It has an air of sophistication that you wouldn't normally expect from monsters.

items.name: Pure Light Ingot
items.flavour: A small piece of metal with remarkable properties, which modern smiths are entirely unable to replicate. The archaeologists in Thanatos Tower might be able to help you make use of this.

items.name: Coral Bangle
items.flavour: A small bracelet of polished coral worn by the worshipers in the Rgan Sacred Ground. It denotes those who have been given the authority to bestow the World Serpent's blessing.

items.name: Seaweed Belt
items.flavour: A large belt made of seaweed harvested near the Rgan Sacred Ground, often worn by those who have come to seek the World Serpent's blessing.

items.name: Toxic Scales
items.flavour: Hard, armor-like scales infused with a deadly poison harvested from the Predator in the depths of the Rgan Tunnels. It's hard to believe that monster was ever human.

items.name: Iceslug Cluster
items.flavour: A cluster of cells that once made up part of a large iceslug. Though it attacked you like all the other wildlife in the area, it looked dangerously close to being intelligent...

items.name: Gigantic Serpent Fang
items.flavour: A massive, hollow fang taken from a snake that must have been of unimaginable size. Though only barely, there are still traces of the original owner's deadly toxin on it. Very rare.

items.name: Angel's Tail
items.flavour: The tail of the horrifying Angel Iceslug sealed within the Ancient Altar in the Far North. It's existence is proof that the Nightmare's corruption has spread to every corner of the world. Very rare.

items.name: Frostwind Feather
items.flavour: A large grey feather taken from a Frostwind, one of the enormous birds native to the Far North.

items.name: Icewind Feather
items.flavour: A large white feather taken from an Icewind, one of the enormous birds native to the Far North.

items.name: Mutated Scale
items.flavour: A scale taken from one of the creatures in the Rgan Tunnels in the Far North. This one was taken from a Rgan that had yet to fully transform.

items.name: Burning Shard
items.flavour: A shard made of an unknown material that is perpetually searing hot, no matter how long it has to cool.

items.name: Astral Crystal
items.flavour: A crystalline fragment broken off of the Astral Guardian, an otherworldly construct protecting the lower levels of the Astral Tower.

items.name: Blazing Ruby
items.flavour: A ruby cloaked in eternal fire plucked from the remains of a Flux Titan. Something deep in the Magma Caverns must be transforming these monsters...is this jewel a clue?

items.name: Sealed Rune
items.flavour: A small, powerful rune sealed within a circle of others found on the Memory of Justice in Ancient Odin's Temple. What was its purpose that it needed to be sealed like this? And who exactly sealed it?

items.name: World Serpent's Catechism
items.flavour: A sacred text belonging to the Jordos Judge guarding the Temple of the World Serpent's entrance. Unfortunately, it doesn't seem to contain any clues on how one might enter the Temple itself. Very rare.

items.name: Spider Leg
items.flavour: The leg of a massive spider that lurks on outskirts of the Good Turtle's Village, feeding off its residents.

items.name: Fatebound Scale
effect: A single scale shed from a large snake. It emanates an incredible power, which has been sealed and suppressed to make it safe to carry. Could this scale really be from Jormungandr himself...?
A component of the Legendary Staff Jormungandr's Wrath

items.name: Serpent Emblem
items.flavour: An emblem carried by those that inhabit the Temple of the World Serpent. Only those who have proven themselves worthy of Jormungandr's favor are permitted to carry it.

items.name: Fatebound Soul
items.flavour: The condensed souls of countless Rgan, Jorgan, and Jordos worshipers. Even with their mortal lives extinguished, their immortal souls will carry out the will of their master for eternity.

items.name: Shrine Amulet
items.flavour: A small amulet held by the keeper of the Amatsu Shrine. She only grants this honor to those capable of besting her in combat.

items.name: Broken Petal
items.flavour: A fragmented and colorless petal from an otherworldly flower. The vivid color it once boasted faded the moment it broke off from its source.

items.name: Empty Orb
items.flavour: A small glass orb that looks like it might have once been used for magical purposes, but now is entirely void of energy.

items.name: Gluttonous Fang
items.flavour: A massive tooth torn from the jaw of the monster roaming the sealed halls of Rachel Sanctuary.

items.name: Ghostly Grass
items.flavour: A mysterious, ephemeral plant found only in the Hazy Forest. It seems like it might fade from existence at any moment.

items.name: Haze Kunai
effect: Enables use of Throw Kunai at Level 0
Throw Kunai has a chance to inflict Breach
Ninja classes
